MCMC dalam kenyataan hari ini memaklumkan sistem amaran kecemasan negara itu sedang dilaksanakan secara berfasa dengan menggunakan teknologi Cell Broadcast System (CBS).

Limit Order vs Stop Order 📈📉

Buy/Sell limit Order
Set at the price where its expected to move up/down. When the limit order is hit, the positions will be automatically run. 

Buy/Sell Stop Order 
Order is made when predicted price reach the certain price whether it will keep moving up/move down towards that position.

Limit Order is suitable to be used as a trap and Stop Oder can use for price breakout.📱 @nursejannah
